anna_sales: Heads up — FinEdge wants the POC to guarantee inference traffic + logs remain inside Canada (ca-central) or EU (nl-west) only. They also asked for the subprocessor list and a firm answer on egress during failover. Can presales/ops confirm whether we can tenant-lock to a 2-region set and what Dedicated pricing delta looks like? ping @devon_presales @nate_engineer :eyes:

devon_presales: Quick clarifying q — is the ask for a hard lock (no packets leave region at all) or soft affinity (preferential routing, fallback allowed)?

anna_sales: Legal wants hard lock for POC, but engineering can propose acceptable mitigations. Customer says no control-plane leaving region either if possible.

nate_engineer: Short answer: hosted API cannot guarantee control-plane locality, telemetry may touch control plane in primary region. We can implement tenant affinity for inference via routing policies and disable cross-region failover for the POC, but true hard isolation requires Dedicated with VPC peering or a Private deployment. Example routing config we can spin up for POC:

```
routing:
  tenant_affinity: [ca-central1, nl-west]
  failover: none
  control_plane_signaling: best-effort
  kv_cache_replication: region-local
```

This will keep serving in those regions, but note app logs and billing events might still be visible by our control plane unless Private.

olga_security: I can share the validated subprocessor inventory for CA/NL and the min compliance checklist. Link: https://redwood.example.com/security/subprocessors (internal). BYOK is available in Dedicated & Private. For Hosted POC we can do customer-managed KMS via tokenized key if they sign the MSA addendum. :lock:

mike_ops: Pricing: short POC (2 weeks, small footprint) — Hosted with geo-affinity: no price change but no SLA. Dedicated short-term reserved pool for geo-lock adds ~20% ops overhead + any cross-region standby hosts. If they want strict isolation we should quote Dedicated monthly commit; rough thumb: add ~25% on top of standard Dedicated quote. I'll follow up with exact numbers in the quote doc.

anna_sales: OK — two asks from FinEdge: (1) subprocessor list + compliance checklist (2) written confirmation of what we can/cannot guarantee for POC. olga, nate — can you draft bullet answers by EOD? devon, mike — can you put together a scoped quote for 2-week POC and a longer Dedicated option? :thumbsup:

olga_security: On it. I'll upload the subproc CSV and a one-pager describing telemetry/control-plane caveats.

nate_engineer: I'll draft the POC network/runbook and the minimal config to enforce region affinity. Will include steps for smoke tests and a checklist for the customer's infra team.

deploy-bot: staging:region-affinity-ca-nl deployed by nate_engineer at 2025-11-04T15:22:03Z

devon_presales: Thanks — looping in solutions-engineering to review. If we need strict legal attestation we'll route to Legal ops. leaving notes here.

anna_sales: Great — I’ll set a short call with the customer for tomorrow 10am PT to align expectations. Thanks everyone.
